notes: Recovery trials exposed Windows long paths and PowerShell empty environment variables. The build setup was corrected; the final source files and dependencies match those used for the clean JPS product compilation.

The final archive was separately restored and prepared. All its files were checked against the recovered payload; its dependency payload and actual compilation inputs match the completed offline build.

After clean compilation, the managed sandbox denied the native local DirectoryLock socket used by packaging self-checks. Packaging was retried with local IPC permitted and the same Java external-network guard enabled.
Sandbox-to-normal account switching required a process-local safe.directory entry for the dedicated restored upstream path. No global Git trust configuration was changed.

Offline settings indexing also required a build-only idea.plugins.host override to avoid an optional Marketplace metadata refresh. The successful packaging log retains the external-network guard; runtime product options do not contain the override.

Other optional Marketplace client requests still attempted plugins.jetbrains.com and were denied by the guard. Those interceptions appear as exceptions in the log; they did not prevent dependency resolution, settings indexing or packaging from completing.
ZIP timestamp differences are expected. This verifies source rebuilding, not identical whole-ZIP hashes.
